title: Edge proxy acceptor and contract enricher for usage events
creator: Maya Patel
description:
Background: Console telemetry traffic has grown ~3x with more tenant-specific schema variants (v1/v2/experimental) and increased burstiness from agent rollouts. Current monolithic intake either rejects events aggressively or accepts malformed payloads downstream, which causes lost metrics and noisy downstream fixes. Goal: introduce a lightweight edge proxy that performs fast contract checks, tenant-aware sampling/enrichment, and a configurable soft-accept policy so downstream systems get a canonical baseline of events while preserving signal for debugging and rollouts.

Scope: build an Edge Proxy Acceptor service deployed in front of the existing intake (multi-region). Responsibilities: (1) fast schema sniff + contract check using cached lightweight validators, (2) perform tenant mapping and add authoritative tenant metadata and routing tags, (3) apply sampling and adaptive downsampling rules per tenant and event-class, (4) implement soft-accept fallback where events with non-critical schema issues are tagged and forwarded to a quarantine topic instead of being dropped, (5) emit fine-grained metrics (validation_latency_ms, accept_rate, quarantine_rate, sampled_rate) and traces.

Design decisions: we will keep validation fast and local by using a two-tier validator: a compiled wasm-based fast-check for common shape assertions and a secondary async full-validator in the main intake for deep checks. Soft-accept policy configurable by feature flags per tenant (default off for PII-sensitive tenants). Enrichment step adds: canonical_tenant_id, schema_version_detected, accepted_by (proxy id), sampled=true/false, and preferred_route (console/dedicated). Backpressure will be signalled via HTTP 429 with Retry-After and via a lightweight token-bucket for bursts to avoid thundering herd.

Success metrics: reduce hard-drops due to minor schema mismatches by 90% for traffic using soft-accept; reduce downstream schema-fix PR volume by 40% in quarter; proxy median p95 validation latency < 6ms; quarantine topic not exceeding 5% of traffic for steady-state tenants.

Rollout plan: 1) Canary in staging with 10% of console traffic for 48h, compare accept/quarantine counts and latency. 2) Gradual ramp to 30% in two days, then tenant-by-tenant opt-in via feature flag. 3) After 2 weeks of stable metrics, flip default soft-accept for non-sensitive tenants, full rollout with monitoring dashboards and automated alerting to SRE.

Operational notes: service must expose /healthz and /metrics, support graceful drain, and have a simple local cache eviction policy for schema validators (LRU based capped at 8k entries). Must log sample of quarantined payloads to secure storage for 30d for debugging.

Implementation tasks (this ticket): (A) service skeleton + HTTP acceptor and config flags, (B) integrate wasm fast-check validators and schema cache, (C) tenant mapping/enrichment module, (D) sampling rules engine + backpressure, (E) soft-accept/quarantine wiring (Kafka topic), (F) metrics/traces and dashboard queries, (G) canary/runbook. Other smaller tasks are split into sub-issues.
comments: 2025-02-14 - Maya Patel: Initial RFC and triage. Proposed two-tier validation (wasm fast-check + async full). Recorded estimate 8 pts. Added dependencies on schema-registry migration work.
2025-02-20 - Jonah Rivera: Reviewed and approved technical approach. Concern raised about wasm cold-start cost; proposing a warm pool and precompile step. Assigned to me for prototype.

2025-02-27 - Jonah Rivera: Prototype complete. Wasm validator micro-benchmark: median 1.8ms on m6i-like instance, p95 5.6ms. Warm pool reduced p95 to 3.1ms. Pushed branch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ingest-proxy/pull/142

2025-03-03 - Grace Lin (SRE): Can we limit quarantine write QPS and ensure retention plan? Proposed Kafka topic partitions = number of proxy replicas * 2 and a consumer to backfill to secure S3 for manual inspection.

2025-03-07 - Jonah Rivera: Added backpressure behavior: token-bucket per-tenant with global circuit-breaker. Updated runbook skeleton in Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ENG/pages/edge-proxy-runbook
2025-03-12 - PM Review - Rafael Gomez: Added acceptance criteria and customer impact notes. Request to expose per-tenant quarantine_rate metric in console dashboards.

2025-03-15 - QA - Laila O.: Integration tests written for accepted vs quarantined flows; found edge-case where nested optional arrays caused false positives. We added a validation tuple to relax this pattern under schema v2.0-beta.
2025-03-20 - Jonah Rivera: Preparing canary manifests and feature flag gate. Next: run canary in us-west-2 with 5% traffic and monitor for 48 hours.
